{{Top|leg}}
The '''malledillo''' was a small armored creature that had once been native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuuzhan'tar]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The malledillos were bred to to have an exceptionally strong shell and they were used as hammers or mallets by the Yuuzhan Vong.
